body:
### About Me.
***
I am a student who is studying Computer Science at the University of Massachusetts Amherst. I am really passionate about creating software and I really like solving problems through code. Right now, I am searching for technical internships to gain experience in the industry and build a great foundation for the later work that I do. As of right now, I am very interested in machine learning and data science. I really am passionate about data and love finding knowledge and insight through data. I believe that machine learning could solve many of the world's problems and that is why I am so interested in it. 


On my free time, I like to learn about new technologies and like to create small projects to build my portfolio/knowledge. I also a sports fanatic; I like watching football and basketball and especially love playing basketball.  


### Projects
---
**My Health Prognosticator** - Analyzes United Health Group patient data to make health predictions for a user given their past medical history. 

**Kumi** - Allows users to send distress signals (via phone call, text, email) to friends and family when they are in danger with a press of a button on a BLE (Bluetooth low energy) device.

**Tweets2News** - Chrome Extension that allows users to find articles based on the tweets they are interested in Twitter.

**Subreddit-Email** - A simple script that I created that emails you the top links of your favorite subreddits without having to go into Reddit and open up different tabs for each subreddit. The email contains the top 10 submissions of your favorite subreddit with links to the original submission.
